brand.description: Brand file path (relative to the project) or `default` for the bundled brand.

chroma.description:
Chroma subsampling of the deliverable: `420` (default, plays everywhere) or `444` (full
color resolution: no fringes on small colored text; not all players support it).

cues.description:
Named points in the voice-over, found in its transcript: `{clocks: "World clocks"}`.
Timeline times (layer `start`/`end`, sfx `at`, clip `end_at`, marker `at`) can refer to
them as `"cue:clocks"`, `"cue:clocks+0.4"` or `"cue:clocks-0.2"`.

default_reframe.description: Default geometry for clips whose aspect differs from the target (default `cover`).

fps.description: Timeline fps. Defaults from the target (long-form targets follow the first clip's source).

main.description: Main storyline: clips, with transitions between them.

profile.description:
`screencast`: tuned for screen and terminal recordings (sharper text encoding; frozen
frames are expected, so QA does not warn about them).

target.description: Output target preset (geometry, fps, encoder, safe zones).

alpha.description: Asset is expected to carry alpha (validated against probe).

fps.description: Frame rate for image sequences / HTML renders.

kind.description: Auto-detected from ffprobe and the extension when omitted.

params.description: Parameters injected into HTML templates as `window.__cutline_params`.

path.description: Path relative to the project file. Image sequences use a printf pattern (`frames/%05d.png`).

script.description:
The text that was spoken (relative path to a .txt file), e.g. the TTS script. Captions
and cues then use the script's exact words, timed from the transcript.

synthetic.description: Mark this asset as AI-generated (affects the publishing checklist).

transcript.description: Transcript for this asset: Scribe JSON or cutline transcript JSON (relative path).

width.description: Render size for HTML/SVG/Lottie (defaults to the target size).

dialogue_chain.description: Chain applied to dialogue (main clip audio); default same as voice_chain.

micro_fade.description: Micro-fade length at cuts in seconds (default 0.01).

voice_chain.description: clean_voice | podcast_warm | raw — applied to voice (VO) assets.

sfx_on_transitions.description: SFX asset/alias auto-placed on every transition.

oneOf.description: Transcribe / import transcripts and map words through the edit.
Use `file` (SRT or cutline transcript JSON in timeline time).

assets.description: Asset ids whose transcripts feed captions (default: all clip assets + voice layers).

emoji.description: Emoji to append to emphasis words (word → emoji name).

position.description: lower_mid (default) | center | upper_mid | bottom | top, or {x, y}

size.description: Font size in px at the output resolution.

audio.description: Clip audio: keep (default), mute, duck (−12 dB), or an asset id replacing it.

chapter.description: Chapter title (long form); defaults to the clip id when the clip starts a chapter.

duration.description: Timeline duration for stills / generated assets.

end_at.description:
Timeline time of the cut to the next clip (the middle of the outgoing transition), e.g.
`"cue:calendar"`. The clip is fitted to end there: with `in` and `out` both set its
speed is computed; otherwise `out` is (at `speed`, default 1); stills get the duration.

id.description: Unique id (used for anchors, chapters, review output).

out.description: Source out point (default: end of the asset).

reverse.description: Play the clip backwards (short clips only).

lut.description: Bundled LUT name or a `.cube` path relative to the project.

Cue.description: A cue: a phrase in a voice track. The short form is just the phrase.

asset.description: Asset whose transcript is searched. Default: the only voice-role audio layer's asset.

edge.description: `start` (default): when the first word begins; `end`: when the last word ends.

occurrence.description: Which occurrence of the phrase (1-based, default 1).

phrase.description: Words to find (case and punctuation are ignored; close transcription slips match).

oneOf.description: Quick zoom in at `at` (clip-relative seconds), holding until `hold` ends, then optionally out.

focus.description: Zoom focus point in output-normalized coordinates (default center).

hold.description: Seconds to hold the zoom (default: until clip end).

oneOf.description:
Zoom so `rect` (fractions of the frame) fills the view, starting at `start`
(clip-relative) over `duration`; zoom back out from `end` if set.

end.description: Clip-relative time to start zooming back out (same duration and ease).

padding.description: Margin around the rect as a fraction of the frame (default 0.03).

oneOf.description: Hold the frame at `at` (clip-relative) for `duration` seconds (extends the clip).

chroma.description: Overrides the project's `chroma` for this export.

name.description: Export name (used in the output file name). Defaults to the target name.

out.description: Output path (relative to the project). Default `out/<name>.mp4`.

Fps.description: Frames per second: number (30, 29.97) or rational string "30000/1001".

oneOf.description:
Text template (hook_title, lower_third, callout, step_counter, big_number, quote,
cta_subscribe, end_card, emoji_pop).

anchor.description: Main clip id this layer follows.

offset.description: Seconds after the anchor clip's start.

scale.description: Width as a fraction of the frame width (1 = full width).

start.description: Absolute timeline start (seconds/timecode). Ignored when `anchor` is set.

z.description: Stacking order (higher = on top). Default: order in `layers`.

offset.description: Seconds after the anchor clip's start.

start.description: Absolute timeline start (seconds/timecode). Ignored when `anchor` is set.

z.description: Stacking order (higher = on top). Default: order in `layers`.

oneOf.description: B-roll (full-frame cover by default, or PiP with scale/position).

anchor.description: Main clip id this layer follows.

offset.description: Seconds after the anchor clip's start.

scale.description: Width as a fraction of the frame width (1 = full width).

start.description: Absolute timeline start (seconds/timecode). Ignored when `anchor` is set.

z.description: Stacking order (higher = on top). Default: order in `layers`.

offset.description: Seconds after the anchor clip's start.

start.description: Absolute timeline start (seconds/timecode). Ignored when `anchor` is set.

z.description: Stacking order (higher = on top). Default: order in `layers`.

oneOf.description: HTML/Lottie/SVG asset rendered via headless Chrome.

anchor.description: Main clip id this layer follows.

offset.description: Seconds after the anchor clip's start.

scale.description: Width as a fraction of the frame width (1 = full width).

start.description: Absolute timeline start (seconds/timecode). Ignored when `anchor` is set.

z.description: Stacking order (higher = on top). Default: order in `layers`.

anchor.description: Main clip id this layer follows.

height.description: Height in px (default 12 for shorts, 8 otherwise).

offset.description: Seconds after the anchor clip's start.

start.description: Absolute timeline start (seconds/timecode). Ignored when `anchor` is set.

anchor.description: Main clip id this layer follows.

loop.description: Loop the asset to fill the span.

offset.description: Seconds after the anchor clip's start.

start.description: Absolute timeline start (seconds/timecode). Ignored when `anchor` is set.

oneOf.description:
Hide part of the frame: usernames, paths, emails, keys. Drawn over the footage and other
overlays (below text and captions).

anchor.description: Main clip id this layer follows.

mode.description:
blur (default) | pixelate | fill. Use `fill` for secrets: blurred or pixelated text
can sometimes be recovered.

offset.description: Seconds after the anchor clip's start.

rect.description: Region as fractions of the frame: `{x, y, w, h}` (top-left corner, size).

start.description: Absolute timeline start (seconds/timecode). Ignored when `anchor` is set.

text.description: Replacement text drawn in the region (left-aligned, vertically centered).

text_size.description: Text size in output px at full resolution (default 60 % of the region height).

asset.description: Asset id, brand SFX alias, or a list to pick from deterministically.

MainItem.description: An element of `main`: either a clip or `{transition: {...}}` between two clips.

Position.description: Position: a preset name or normalized center coordinates.

anyOf.description:
center | top | bottom | left | right | top_left | top_right | bottom_left | bottom_right |
lower_mid | upper_mid

bias.description: Where the subject should sit in the output (default x=0.5, y=0.38).

fallback.description: Fallback when no faces are found (default fit_blur).

keys.description: Manual keys: crop center (x, y in 0..1 of source) and zoom (1 = largest crop).

max_pan_speed.description: Max pan speed in fractions of the frame width per second.

regions.description: Split layout regions (source-normalized rectangles), top then bottom.

subject.description: largest | most_persistent | left | right | index | speaker (experimental)

oneOf.description: Fit inside with a blurred, scaled copy as background.
Fit inside, pad with the brand background color.

top.description: Fractions of the frame kept clear.

t.description: Source-relative time (seconds from the clip's in point).

TimeValue.description: Seconds (number), timecode string "mm:ss.mmm" / "hh:mm:ss.mmm", frames "f:N", "end", or (timeline times only) a cue reference "cue:name" / "cue:name+0.5".

audio.description: Audio behaviour: crossfade (default) or cut (hard cut with micro-fades).

color.description: Flash/fill color for flash_cut and similar.

sfx.description: SFX asset id or brand alias played at the transition midpoint.

type.description:
xfade name (fade, wipeleft, slideup, circleopen, …) or custom: whip_left/right/up/down,
zoom_punch, flash_cut, glitch, cut.
